library(tidyverse)

## metadata samples

```{r}
metadata_sample <- read_tsv("raw/samples/sample_metadata.tsv.gz", show_col_types = F) %>%
  arrange(biome, sample_id) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = as.character(sample_id))

seqkit <- read_tsv("raw/samples/seqkit_cleaned_reads.tsv.gz", show_col_types = F) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = str_match(basename(file), "^(.*?)_R[12]_")[,2],
    read = if_else(str_detect(file, "_R1_"), "R1", "R2")
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    num_paired_seqs = min(num_seqs),
    num_seqs = sum(num_seqs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_len  = sum(sum_len,   na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_len  = sum_len / num_seqs,
    min_len  = min(min_len, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_len  = max(max_len, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

metadata_sample <- metadata_sample %>%
  left_join(seqkit, by = "sample_id")

rm(seqkit)
write_tsv(metadata_sample, "organized/meta_samples.tsv.gz")
```

## metadata taxa

```{r}
gtdbtk <- bind_rows(
  read_tsv("raw/gtdbtk/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv.gz", show_col_types = F),
  read_tsv("raw/gtdbtk/gtdbtk.ar53.summary.tsv.gz", show_col_types = F)
) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(
    classification, 
    delim = ";",
    names = c("domain","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species"), 
    cols_remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(domain:species, ~ str_replace(.x, "^[a-z]__", ""))) %>%
  mutate(across(domain:species, ~ na_if(.x, "Unkown"))) %>%
  mutate(across(domain:species, ~ if_else(.x == "", "Unkown", .x))) %>%
  rename(taxa_id = user_genome)

checkm2 <- list.files("raw/checkm2", pattern = "\\.tsv\\.gz$", full.names = T) %>%
  set_names(str_remove(basename(.), "_quality_report\\.tsv\\.gz$")) %>%
  map(\(x) read_tsv(x, show_col_types = F)) %>%
  list_rbind(names_to = "sample_id") %>%
  rename(taxa_id = Name) %>%
  filter(taxa_id %in% gtdbtk$taxa_id) %>%# take only the dereplicated ones
  mutate(Completeness = if_else(Completeness_Model_Used == "Gradient Boost (General Model)",
                                Completeness_General, Completeness_Specific),
         .after = taxa_id)
  
write_tsv(gtdbtk, "organized/gtbtk.tsv.gz")
write_tsv(checkm2, "organized/checkm2.tsv.gz")
```

## Convert GTDB -\> NCBI

```{r}
# Extract the most specific known GTDB taxon from a GTDB-Tk table.
#
# Assumptions:
# - Input table contains a column named 'classification'
#
# Arguments:
# - gtdbtk     : GTDB-Tk table (data.frame / tibble)
# - extra_cols: character vector of additional column names to keep
#
# Output:
# - tibble with columns:
#   taxon, rank, <extra_cols>
extract_best_gtdb_taxon <- function(gtdbtk, extra_cols = NULL) {

  # Required column
  if (!"classification" %in% colnames(gtdbtk)) {
    cli::cli_abort("Missing required column: 'classification'")
  }

  # Check extra columns
  if (!is.null(extra_cols)) {
    missing_extra <- setdiff(extra_cols, colnames(gtdbtk))
    if (length(missing_extra) > 0) {
      cli::cli_abort("Requested extra column(s) not found: {missing_extra}")
    }
  }

  # Helper: extract best taxon from one classification string
  extract_one <- function(cl) {

    if (is.na(cl) || cl == "") {
      return(tibble(taxon = NA_character_, rank = NA_character_))
    }

    # Split GTDB taxonomy string
    parts <- str_split(cl, ";", simplify = TRUE)
    parts <- parts[parts != ""]

    # Remove empty ranks (e.g. 's__', 'g__')
    parts_ok <- parts[!str_detect(parts, "^[dpcofgs]__$")]

    if (length(parts_ok) == 0) {
      return(tibble(taxon = NA_character_, rank = NA_character_))
    }

    # Most specific known taxon
    taxon <- parts_ok[length(parts_ok)]

    # Extract and decode rank
    prefix <- str_match(taxon, "^([dpcofgs])__")[, 2]
    rank <- dplyr::recode(
      prefix,
      d = "domain",
      p = "phylum",
      c = "class",
      o = "order",
      f = "family",
      g = "genus",
      s = "species",
      .default = NA_character_
    )

    tibble(taxon = taxon, rank = rank)
  }

  # Core extraction
  out <- purrr::map_dfr(gtdbtk$classification, extract_one)

  # Append extra columns if requested
  if (!is.null(extra_cols)) {
    out <- bind_cols(out, gtdbtk[, extra_cols, drop = FALSE])
  }

  out %>%
    select(taxon, rank, everything())
}
```

```{r}
best_gtdbtk <- extract_best_gtdb_taxon(gtdbtk, extra_cols = "taxa_id")
writeLines(best_gtdbtk$taxon, "gtdb_to_ncbi/names_gtdb.txt")
```

```{bash}
mkdir -p raw/gtdb-metadata

aria2c -x 8 -s 8 -d  raw/gtdb-metadata \
  https://data.gtdb.ecogenomic.org/releases/release226/226.0/bac120_metadata_r226.tsv.gz

aria2c -x 8 -s 8 -d raw/gtdb-metadata \
  https://data.gtdb.ecogenomic.org/releases/release226/226.0/ar53_metadata_r226.tsv.gz
```

```{bash}
mkdir -p gtdb_to_ncbi

source "$(conda info --base)/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"
conda activate gtdb_to_taxdump

ncbi-gtdb_map.py -q gtdb_taxonomy gtdb_to_ncbi/names_gtdb.txt \
  raw/gtdb-metadata/ar53_metadata_r226.tsv.gz raw/gtdb-metadata/bac120_metadata_r226.tsv.gz \
  -p 12 -v -o gtdb_to_ncbi
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
gtdb_ncbi_map <- read_tsv("gtdb_to_ncbi/taxonomy_map_summary.tsv.gz")
gtdb_ncbi_map <- gtdb_ncbi_map %>%
  right_join(best_gtdbtk, join_by(gtdb_taxonomy == taxon)) %>%
  rename(ncbi_rank = target_tax_level, ncbi_lineage = lineage, gtdb_rank = rank) %>%
  relocate(taxa_id, gtdb_taxonomy, ncbi_taxonomy, gtdb_rank, ncbi_rank,
           lca_frac, ncbi_lineage) %>%
  mutate(method = "assembly-based", 
         .before = 1)
```

```{r}
write_tsv(gtdb_ncbi_map, "organized/map_gtdbtk_ncbi.tsv.gz")
```

## Kaiju

```{r, message=FALSE}
count_kaiju <- read_tsv("raw/kaiju_sewage-milk_mags/SPECIE_count.tab.gz")  %>%
  filter(rowSums(across(-Taxa, ~ .x > 0)) >= 10) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Taxa") %>%
  t %>%
  as_tibble(rownames = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(sample_id = str_remove_all(sample_id, 'specie.|.out.txt')) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")

```

```{r}
best_kaiju <- colnames(count_kaiju)
writeLines(best_kaiju, "ncbi_to_gtdb/names_ncbi.txt")
```

```{bash}
mkdir -p ncbi_to_gtdb

source "$(conda info --base)/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"
conda activate gtdb_to_taxdump

ncbi-gtdb_map.py ncbi_to_gtdb/names_ncbi.txt \
  raw/gtdb-metadata/ar53_metadata_r226.tsv.gz raw/gtdb-metadata/bac120_metadata_r226.tsv.gz \
  -N -p 12 -v -o ncbi_to_gtdb
```

```{r}
kaiju_gtdb_map <- read_tsv("ncbi_to_gtdb/taxonomy_map_summary.tsv.gz",
                           show_col_types = F)
kaiju_gtdb_map <- kaiju_gtdb_map %>%
  rename(gtdb_rank = target_tax_level, gtdb_lineage = lineage) %>%
  mutate(method = "kaiju", 
         .before = 1)
```

### Kaiju full taxonomy of species

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(taxizedb)
library(furrr)

# Example:
# kaiju_names <- c("Bacteroides fragilis", "Escherichia coli", "cicciopasticcio")

# Retrieve NCBI taxids from taxizedb
ncbiID <- taxizedb::name2taxid(best_kaiju)

# Helper function to extract the taxonomy ranks for a single taxid
get_ncbi_ranks <- function(taxid) {
  # Taxonomic ranks we want to extract
  ranks <- c("species", "genus", "family", "order", "class", "phylum")
  
  # If taxid is NA (name not found), return a list of NAs
  if (is.na(taxid)) {
    return(as.list(setNames(rep(NA_character_, length(ranks)), ranks)))
  }
  
  # Retrieve full classification for that taxid
  cl <- taxizedb::classification(taxid)[[1]]
  
  # Extract the taxon names corresponding to the ranks of interest
  out <- cl$name[match(ranks, cl$rank)]
  
  # Assign names and return as a list
  out <- setNames(as.list(out), ranks)
  
  out
}

# Set up parallel plan (change workers according to your machine)
plan(multisession, workers = 12)

# Build the initial tibble
taxa_kaiju <- tibble(
  input_name = best_kaiju,
  taxid      = ncbiID
) %>% 
  # 2. Apply helper function in parallel using future_map
  mutate(classif = future_map(taxid, get_ncbi_ranks)) %>% 
  # 3. Expand the classification list into separate columns
  unnest_wider(classif)
```

```{r}
taxa_kaiju <- taxa_kaiju %>%
  rename(taxa_id = input_name, species_ncbi_id = taxid, species_taxize = species) 
```

```{r}
write_tsv(taxa_kaiju, "organized/taxa_kaiju.tsv.gz")
```

## Genus

```{r}
read_genus_ass <- coverm %>%
  select(sample_id, taxa_id, read_count) %>%
  left_join(select(gtdbtk, taxa_id, genus), by = "taxa_id") %>%
  filter(taxa_id != "unmapped") %>%
  summarise(read_count = sum(read_count), .by = c("sample_id", "genus")) %>%
  filter(genus != "Unkown") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "genus", values_from = "read_count") %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")
```

```{r}
taxa_gtdb_genus <- gtdbtk %>%
  select(taxa_id, classification) %>%
  mutate(classification = str_remove(classification, ";s__.*$")) %>%
  select(-taxa_id) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  bind_cols(extract_best_gtdb_taxon(.)) %>%
  filter(rank == "genus") %>%
  mutate(taxon = str_remove_all(taxon, "g__")) %>%
  column_to_rownames("taxon")
taxa_gtdb_genus <- taxa_gtdb_genus[colnames(read_genus_ass), ]
```
